text:
sophie: Quick note - team dry-run planned Friday 09:30 PT. Goal: rehearse announcement path, SI onboarding flow, and partner co-marketing handoff. 30m.

kevin: I'll bring the CDN purge script and the cache TTL matrix. also need final SVGs in `/assets/partners/svg/` by Thursday 15:00 PT. Can someone confirm PNG fallbacks?

ajay: SI integration smoke tests are green in staging. Caveat: SSO token rotation test fails intermittently. I put a ticket in JIRA: INF-3247. Will attempt fix tonight.

maria: Press update: partner A wants a different quote than the one legal approved. Legal asked for redline; we need a final signoff by EOD Thu or they'll refuse embargo.

olivia: I can run the partner blurb sync with marketing. Propose a shared sheet: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/marketplace-co-marketing` with columns: logo, blurb (<=150 chars), contact, embargo-ok (Y/N).

sam-engineering: Ops note: make sure CI job `marketplace/deploy/verify-partners` runs before tagging release. Also add a `smoke` label in the deploy pipeline so it doesn't auto-promote.

announce-bot: Heads-up: scheduled announcement job created for 2026-06-09T16:00:00Z (embargo). Manual approval required 15m prior.

kevin: For fallback: if partner logos fail to load, we'll show a single generic partner band. add to runbook: `if 4xx on /partners/logo/{id} -> replace with /partners/logo/generic.svg and trigger CDN purge`

ajay: For SI contracts telemetry addendum: short clause ok: "Partner agrees to share anonymized error/usage telemetry for joint debugging" — legal to confirm. I'll circulate a sample addendum in the doc.

maria: Backup for press is @olivia if I'm OOO. Also we need a press checklist: embargo list, contact numbers, simultaneous publish script, and rollback tweet templates.

olivia: Noted. I'll draft the rollback tweet + customer-facing support note. Suggest we pre-write a short FAQ for customers about partner integrations.

kevin: CDN purge command for runbook: `ssh ops@deploy 'curl -X POST https://cdn.internal/purge -H "Authorization: Bearer $CDN" -d "{\"paths\":[\"/partners/*\"]}"'`

sophie: Great. Action items assigned: Kevin (assets + CDN), Ajay (SSO fix + SI addendum), Maria (press signoff), Olivia (co-marketing sheet + FAQ), Sam (CI gate). We'll do dry-run Fri and an emergency-only cutover plan.

maria: One more: hardware partner benchmark blurbs need a compliance note (FIPS/U.S. export) — pinging legal.

announce-bot: Reminder: dry-run calendar invite 2026-06-05 16:30 UTC posted.

kevin: If everyone agrees, I'll schedule a 15m pre-launch lock at T-minus 45m on launch day to freeze content.

sophie: Agree. locking now. If any blocker pops up, add to thread. :white_check_mark:
